core_obligations: Setup (proof lines 5156-5175): replace S by Spec(O_{S,s}) and complete; A = O_{S,s}^wedge, B = O_{T,t}^wedge with A -> B flat and B/mB = O_{T_s,t}^wedge; by lemma-split-node the special fibre has the presentation (A/m)[[x, y]] -> B/mB surjective with kernel (xy).

The improvement step (proof lines 5178-5210): given u, v with uv = h + delta, delta in m^n B, write delta = sum f_i b_i and split each b_i = a_i + u b_{i,1} + v b_{i,2} + delta_i using that u-bar, v-bar generate the maximal ideal of B/mB; then u' = u - sum b_{i,2} f_i, v' = v - sum b_{i,1} f_i satisfy u'v' = h' + delta' with h' in A and delta' in m^{n+1} B, and u - u', v - v' in m^n B.

Limit and conclusion (proof lines 5213-5232): iterating from any lifts u_1, v_1 gives Cauchy sequences with u_n v_n - h_n in m^n B; completeness yields u_infty v_infty = h_infty and an A-algebra map A[[x, y]]/(xy - h_infty) -> B which is surjective (mod m and by completeness) and an isomorphism by algebra-lemma-mod-injective.
proof_roadmap: Localize and complete; record flatness of A -> B and the split-node presentation of the special fibre.
Prove the improvement lemma: correct u, v by elements of m^n B to push the defect uv - h one order deeper into m B.
Iterate and pass to the limit in the complete rings, obtaining u_infty, v_infty, h_infty with u_infty v_infty = h_infty.
Conclude by surjectivity and the flat mod-m isomorphism criterion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the completed normal form of a family at a split node (statement lines 5136-5152). The proof (lines 5154-5232) is a genuine approximation argument: the correction step rewrites the defect uv - h = sum f_i b_i and redistributes each b_i along the surjective mod-m generators u-bar, v-bar, lowering the defect to m^{n+1} B with an explicit formula for u', v', h'; the iteration plus completeness produces the limit relation, and the closing isomorphism uses flatness with the mod-m criterion. H3: the bookkeeping of the correction step and the order-by-order control are a real construction, not a reference chase.
